resources.string: Get a quiet nudge when someone feels your confession, responds to it or follows you, and when a book you read gets a new chapter. Nothing else. You choose which ones in Settings.
Notifications are turned off for Confess on this phone, so you won\'t know when someone feels or answers your words. You can turn them on in your phone\'s settings.
Notifications are on. You\'ll know when your words land.
